 SELECT id, slug, name, parent_id, name, 0 FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL

 SELECT c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.parent_id, tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name, tree.depth+1
 FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id=tree.id
)
SELECT id, slug, breadcrumb FROM tree ORDER BY breadcrumb;

import json, os
from pathlib import Path

r=json.loads((base/'iftm_result.json').read_text())
assert r['record_status']=='verified'
assert len(r['courses'])==114
assert r['government_listing_sources']==['https://www.nirfindia.org/Rankings/2025/OverallRankingALL.html','https://www.nirfindia.org/Rankings/2025/PharmacyRankingALL.html']
assert all(c['official_course_url'].startswith('https://www.iftmuniversity.ac.in/iftmuniversity/') for c in r['courses'])
# Re-extract exact visible names and key fields from each official category table.
def rows(kind):
 s=BeautifulSoup((base/f'iftm_{kind}.html').read_text(errors='replace'),'html.parser')
 return [[' '.join(c.get_text(' ',strip=True).split()) for c in tr.find_all(['th','td'])] for tr in s.find('table').find_all('tr')]
expected=[]
for c in rows('diploma')[1:]: expected.append((c[0],c[1],c[4]))
for c in rows('ug')[1:]: expected.append((c[1],c[2],c[5]) if len(c)>=7 else (c[0],c[1],c[4]))
for c in rows('pg')[1:]: expected.append((c[1],c[2],c[5]) if len(c)>=7 else (c[0],c[1],c[4]))
for i,c in enumerate(rows('doctor')[1:]): expected.append(('Ph.D.',c[2],c[5]) if i==0 else ('Ph.D.',c[1],c[4]))
actual=[(c['name'],c['eligibility'],c['duration']) for c in r['courses']]
assert actual==expected, (len(actual),len(expected), next((x for x in zip(actual,expected) if x[0]"'!=x[1]),None))
# Validate mapping references and breadcrumb copies against read-only sqlite export.
nodes={}
for line in (base/'"'career_nodes.tsv').read_text().splitlines():
 i,s,b=line.split('\\t',2); nodes[(int(i),s)]=b
for c in r['courses']:
 for m in c['career_path_mappings']:
  assert nodes.get((m['career_node_id'],m['career_node_slug']))==m['career_breadcrumb'], (c['name'],m)
assert all(c['mapping_gap'] is None for c in r['courses'])
print('QA PASS: source names, eligibility, durations, counts, domains, mapping ids/slugs/breadcrumbs')
print('catalogue_counts', {x:sum(c['level']==x for c in r['courses']) for x in ['diploma','undergraduate','postgraduate','doctoral']})
PY"
